note: Monthly snapshot. Not a live feed.

endo.title: The ‘missed disease’ that affects 190 million: endometriosis drug shows early promise
endo.description: A modified version of an anti-parasitic drug targets immune cells in endometriosis lesions and reduced disease in early mouse studies, offering a potential non-hormonal treatment path.
endo.author: Nature

endo.title: New £2.4m trial to test endometriosis pain management programme
endo.description: NIHR-funded UK trial will test a remote, endometriosis-specific pain management programme combining CBT-informed therapy, physiotherapy, and medication support for women with persistent pain.
endo.author: NIHR

endo.title: Elagolix Noninferior to Dienogest for Endometriosis Pain in Phase 3 Trial
endo.description: Phase 3 trial in India found elagolix 150 mg noninferior to dienogest for reducing moderate-to-severe endometriosis-associated pain.
endo.author: AJMC

endo.title: Researchers design potential treatment for endometriosis using targeted niclosamide nanotherapy
endo.description: Washington State University team engineered a dendrimer-delivered niclosamide that reduced lesions and pain sensitivity after a single dose in a mouse model.
endo.author: EurekAlert! / WSU

endo.title: A closer look at endometriosis pain: New map reveals key cellular interactions
endo.description: Jackson Laboratory spatial transcriptomics study maps how neurons and immune cells interact in human endometriosis lesions to amplify pain.
endo.author: The Jackson Laboratory

endo.title: Women hail effects of ‘life-changing’ endometriosis drug
endo.description: Patients report substantial relief from newly approved oral GnRH antagonist therapies for endometriosis, helping some return to work and delay surgery.
endo.author: The Times

endo.title: Lotus Endometriosis Institute Expands Robotic Excision Surgery As Demand Grows
endo.description: Institute led by Dr. Steven Vasilev announces expanded capacity for robotic excision of complex endometriosis cases.
endo.author: AP News

endo.title: Endometriosis: one step closer to a diagnostic test using menstrual fluid
endo.description: Pasteur Institute researchers identify five candidate genes in menstrual fluid that could support a future non-invasive diagnostic test.
endo.author: Institut Pasteur

womens.title: Early warning signs of chronic pelvic pain may appear in adolescence, study finds
womens.description: Research suggests adolescent symptoms may predict later chronic pelvic pain, underscoring the need for earlier recognition.
womens.author: Medical Xpress

womens.title: A potential step forward for Cardiff BSGE Endometriosis Centre
womens.description: Welsh government signals possible regional approach to sustain specialist endometriosis services after concerns over the Cardiff centre’s future.
womens.author: Endometriosis UK

womens.title: Endometriosis trial gives hope to millions of women in pain like me
womens.description: BBC profiles a patient and the new NIHR-funded pain management trial aiming to help women whose pain persists after standard treatments.
womens.author: BBC News

womens.title: From Endometriosis to Back Pain: The Medical Cannabis Trials to Watch in 2026
womens.description: ENDOCAN-1 phase 2 feasibility study in Scotland is testing CBD for endometriosis-associated pain.
womens.author: Cannabis Health News

womens.title: Do New Saliva and Blood Tests Diagnose Endometriosis?
womens.description: Overview of emerging non-invasive tests and current professional guidelines, which still do not endorse routine biomarker use for diagnosis.
womens.author: Washington Endometriosis

womens.title: Hormone differences could pave way for endometriosis blood test
womens.description: University of Edinburgh researchers find distinct androgen patterns that correctly identified most endometriosis cases in early testing.
womens.author: Bioscience Today

womens.title: Improving Surgical Planning for Patients with Deep Endometriosis Using Patient-Specific 3-Dimensional Anatomical Models
womens.description: Pilot trial shows 3D-printed models may reduce surgical time and improve planning for deep endometriosis excision.
womens.author: J Obstet Gynaecol Can

womens.title: A long search for a solution to her pain
womens.description: After 18 years of dismissed symptoms, a patient finally receives excision surgery at UCLA Health and reports major improvement.
womens.author: UCLA Health

fertility.title: IVF versus surgery for infertility in women with deep and ovarian endometriosis: a partially randomized patient preference trial
fertility.description: Pragmatic trial finds IVF associated with roughly 2-fold higher live birth rates compared with surgery for infertility in ultrasound-diagnosed deep or ovarian endometriosis.
fertility.author: American Journal of Obstetrics & Gynecology

fertility.title: Patient praises surgical team after life changing endometriosis treatment and long-awaited pregnancy
fertility.description: UK patient becomes pregnant naturally months after specialist excision surgery following years of fertility struggles and pain.
fertility.author: Mid Yorkshire NHS

fertility.title: Continuous estetrol/drospirenone regimen for the treatment of endometriosis-related pain: preliminary results
fertility.description: Retrospective study of continuous E4/DRSP oral contraceptive shows pain reduction and average 30% decrease in endometrioma size over 6 months.
fertility.author: Gynecological Endocrinology

fertility.title: Endometriosis At 14: Grace Macfie’s Story
fertility.description: Teen diagnosed via excision surgery at age 14 shares her journey to help other young patients recognize symptoms earlier.
fertility.author: Endometriosis Foundation of America

fertility.title: Rethinking first-line progestin use in endometriosis: a comparative therapeutic review
fertility.description: Review argues for long-acting progestin delivery strategies better suited to chronic endometriosis management and adherence.
fertility.author: Drugs & Therapy Perspectives

fertility.title: New Blood Test Detects Missed Endometriosis Cases
fertility.description: Multi-omic blood assay identified over 60% of histologically confirmed endometriosis cases missed by ultrasound or MRI.
fertility.author: EMJ

fertility.title: Protecting female fertility: recent advances in medical therapies for endometriosis
fertility.description: Review of traditional and emerging targeted therapies focused on fertility preservation in endometriosis.
fertility.author: Chinese General Practice

fertility.title: Doctor With Stage IV Endometriosis Shares Her 15-Year Journey
fertility.description: Physician and patient describes delayed diagnosis and relief after excision surgery, highlighting systemic challenges even for clinicians.
fertility.author: Endometriosis Foundation of America

medical.title: Tapeworm Treatment Shows Early Effectiveness Against Endometriosis
medical.description: Dendrimer-linked niclosamide reduced lesion size and pain sensitivity in mice; human trials still needed.
medical.author: ScienceAlert

medical.title: New drug for endometriosis could offer ‘breakthrough’ in treatment, scientists say
medical.description: Independent coverage of the WSU targeted niclosamide nanotherapy that remained effective for at least two weeks after a single injection in mice.
medical.author: The Independent

medical.title: Aiming at a chronic women's disease, WSU team develops a potential treatment for endometriosis
medical.description: Local coverage of the Washington State University nanotherapy research and next steps toward clinical testing.
medical.author: The Spokesman-Review

medical.title: Noninvasive Blood-Based Detection of Endometriosis Can Improve Standard-of-Care

medical.title: Menstrual blood as a diagnostic tool for endometriosis: systematic review

medical.title: Tapeworm drug could be powerful treatment for endometriosis, early mouse study hints
medical.description: Live Science summary of the Advanced Healthcare Materials study on targeted niclosamide delivery.
medical.author: Live Science

medical.title: Looking ahead: new approaches to the diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation of patients with deep infiltrating endometriosis
medical.description: Review covers molecular markers, AI-assisted imaging, targeted pathways, and multidisciplinary rehabilitation for deep infiltrating endometriosis.
medical.author: FARMAKOEKONOMIKA

medical.title: How a drug for TAPEWORMS could end the crippling pain of condition suffered by one in 10 women
medical.description: Coverage of the preclinical niclosamide nanotherapy findings and remaining steps before human trials.
medical.author: The Sun

heartwarming.title: A long search for a solution to her pain

heartwarming.author: UCLA Health

heartwarming.description: Teen and her mother share how early recognition and excision surgery gave Grace validation and a path forward after years of dismissed pain.

heartwarming.description: Sannah became pregnant naturally months after specialist excision surgery following years of pain and infertility; she reports symptoms are gone.
